effect: The cover protects the developing tubers while leaving the shoots exposed to light and preserving drainage and airflow. The chapter is complete.
reaction: I appreciated seeing how the cover protects one part of the plant without blocking what the rest needs.

mostWorthwhile.text: Fitting the potato cover was most worthwhile because its explanation connected light protection with the shoots, drainage and airflow.

leastWorthwhile.text: Making the opaque cover was a predictable intermediate step with little explanation on its own.

surprise.text: The cover is a skirt that shades the root space while leaving openings for the shoots, rather than simply covering the whole bed.

arbitrary.text: No action felt particularly arbitrary; even the only available combinations had an apparent purpose.

continue.text: I would choose to continue, partly to see how the crops develop and whether the story reveals more practical details about growing food on Mars.
